answer.rationale: The 18% mandate with incumbent refusal creates a forcing condition that eliminates renewal and negotiation as viable options within 14 days. memory_c2 demonstrates that switching to the low-cost vendor is operationally feasible with quick onboarding and accurate invoicing—evidence of reduced delivery risk. At 94% volume utilization we have no buffer, so adding second source (memory_c3 pattern) would distribute risk but not meet the 18% cost target. Deferral forfeits the contract entirely and creates a gap. Switching primary vendor directly addresses both cost mandate and timeline constraint. Verifying memory_c2 confirms the low-cost vendor's track record on execution quality before committing.
